sentences.text_target: The manager called a department meeting for Monday morning.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈmænɪdʒər kɔːld ə dɪˈpɑːrtmənt ˈmiːtɪŋ fɔːr ˈmʌndeɪ ˈmɔːrnɪŋ/
sentences.text_native: Le manager a convoqué une réunion de service pour lundi matin.

sentences.text_target: Sarah prepared her presentation thoroughly over the weekend.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈsærə prɪˈpɛrd hɜːr ˌprɛzənˈteɪʃən ˈθɜːrəli ˈoʊvər ðə ˈwiːkɛnd/
sentences.text_native: Sarah a préparé sa présentation minutieusement pendant le week-end.

sentences.text_target: She checked the schedule to confirm the exact time.
sentences.phonetic: /ʃi tʃɛkt ðə ˈskɛdʒʊl tu kənˈfɜːrm ði ɪɡˈzækt taɪm/
sentences.text_native: Elle a vérifié le planning pour confirmer l'heure exacte.

sentences.text_target: Her main objective was to discuss the new company strategy.
sentences.phonetic: /hɜːr meɪn əbˈdʒɛktɪv wʌz tu dɪˈskʌs ðə nuː ˈkʌmpəni ˈstrætədʒi/
sentences.text_native: Son objectif principal était de discuter de la nouvelle stratégie de l'entreprise.

sentences.text_target: She wanted to highlight the recent growth of the business.
sentences.phonetic: /ʃi ˈwɑːntɪd tu ˈhaɪlaɪt ðə ˈriːsənt ɡroʊθ ʌv ðə ˈbɪznɪs/
sentences.text_native: Elle voulait mettre en avant la croissance récente de l'entreprise.

sentences.text_target: The first slide showed the results of the previous quarter.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə fɜːrst slaɪd ʃoʊd ðə rɪˈzʌlts ʌv ðə ˈpriːviəs ˈkwɔːrtər/
sentences.text_native: La première diapositive montrait les résultats du trimestre précédent.

sentences.text_target: Colleagues listened carefully as she explained how they achieved their goals.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈkɑːliːɡz ˈlɪsənd ˈkɛrfəli æz ʃi ɪkˈspleɪnd haʊ ðeɪ əˈtʃiːvd ðɛr ɡoʊlz/
sentences.text_native: Les collègues ont écouté attentivement lorsqu'elle a expliqué comment ils avaient atteint leurs objectifs.

sentences.text_target: She pointed at the chart illustrating the local market share.
sentences.phonetic: /ʃi ˈpɔɪntɪd æt ðə tʃɑːrt ˈɪləstreɪtɪŋ ðə ˈloʊkəl ˈmɑːrkɪt ʃɛr/
sentences.text_native: Elle a pointé le graphique illustrant la part de marché locale.

sentences.text_target: A detailed competitor analysis was necessary to understand the situation.
sentences.phonetic: /ə ˈdiːteɪld kəmˈpɛtɪtər əˈnæləsɪs wʌz ˈnɛsəsəri tu ˌʌndərˈstænd ðə ˌsɪtʃuˈeɪʃən/
sentences.text_native: Une analyse détaillée de la concurrence était nécessaire pour comprendre la situation.

sentences.text_target: Fortunately, their revenue had increased significantly this year.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈfɔːrtʃənətli, ðɛr ˈrɛvənuː hæd ˈɪnkriːst sɪɡˈnɪfɪkəntli ðɪs jɪr/
sentences.text_native: Heureusement, leur chiffre d'affaires avait augmenté de façon significative cette année.

sentences.text_target: At the same time, they managed to reduce operational expenses.
sentences.phonetic: /æt ðə seɪm taɪm, ðeɪ ˈmænɪdʒd tu rɪˈduːs ˌɑːpəˈreɪʃənəl ɪkˈspɛnsɪz/
sentences.text_native: En même temps, ils ont réussi à réduire les dépenses opérationnelles.

sentences.text_target: This smart decision directly improved the overall profit margin.
sentences.phonetic: /ðɪs smɑːrt dɪˈsɪʒən daɪˈrɛktli ɪmˈpruːvd ði ˈoʊvərɔːl ˈprɑːfɪt ˈmɑːrdʒɪn/
sentences.text_native: Cette décision judicieuse a directement amélioré la marge bénéficiaire globale.

sentences.text_target: Efficiency in the office became much better than before.
sentences.phonetic: /ɪˈfɪʃənsi ɪn ði ˈɔːfɪs bɪˈkeɪm mʌtʃ ˈbɛtər ðæn bɪˈfɔːr/
sentences.text_native: L'efficacité au bureau s'est nettement améliorée par rapport à avant.

sentences.text_target: Every employee received special training during the spring.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈɛvri ɪmˈplɔɪiː rɪˈsiːvd ˈspɛʃəl ˈtreɪnɪŋ ˈdʊrɪŋ ðə sprɪŋ/
sentences.text_native: Chaque employé a reçu une formation spécifique au cours du printemps.

sentences.text_target: Sarah took a short sip of water from her glass.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈsærə tʊk ə ʃɔːrt sɪp ʌv ˈwɔːtər frʌm hɜːr ɡlæs/
sentences.text_native: Sarah a pris une petite gorgée d'eau dans son verre.

sentences.text_target: She looked around the room to engage with every person.
sentences.phonetic: /ʃi lʊkt əˈraʊnd ðə ruːm tu ɪnˈɡeɪdʒ wɪð ˈɛvri ˈpɜːrsən/
sentences.text_native: Elle a balayé la pièce du regard pour s'adresser à tout le monde.

sentences.text_target: People nodded in agreement while she spoke clearly.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈpiːpəl ˈnɑːdɪd ɪn əˈɡriːmənt waɪl ʃi spoʊk ˈklɪrli/
sentences.text_native: Les gens ont hoché la tête en signe d'approbation pendant qu'elle parlait clairement.

sentences.text_target: She welcomed feedback and constructive suggestions from her colleagues.
sentences.phonetic: /ʃi ˈwɛlkəmd ˈfiːdbæk ænd kənˈstrʌktɪv səˈdʒɛstʃənz frʌm hɜːr ˈkɑːliːɡz/
sentences.text_native: Elle a accueilli favorablement les retours et les suggestions constructives de ses collègues.

sentences.text_target: One colleague raised his hand to ask a relevant question.
sentences.phonetic: /wʌn ˈkɑːliːɡ reɪzd hɪz hænd tu æsk ə ˈrɛləvənt ˈkwɛstʃən/
sentences.text_native: Un collègue a levé la main pour poser une question pertinente.

sentences.text_target: She answered the inquiry with confidence and a warm smile.
sentences.phonetic: /ʃi ˈænsərd ði ˈɪŋkwəri wɪð ˈkɑːnfɪdəns ænd ə wɔːrm smaɪl/
sentences.text_native: Elle a répondu à la question avec assurance et un sourire chaleureux.

sentences.text_target: The computer screen displayed the final action plan.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə kəmˈpjuːtər skriːn dɪˈspleɪd ðə ˈfaɪnəl ˈækʃən plæn/
sentences.text_native: L'écran de l'ordinateur affichait le plan d'action final.

sentences.text_target: She clicked the remote control to show the next slide.
sentences.phonetic: /ʃi klɪkt ðə rɪˈmoʊt kənˈtroʊl tu ʃoʊ ðə nɛkst slaɪd/
sentences.text_native: Elle a cliqué sur la télécommande pour afficher la diapositive suivante.

sentences.text_target: The laser pointer highlighted the core elements of the project.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈleɪzər ˈpɔɪntər ˈhaɪlaɪtɪd ðə kɔːr ˈɛləmənts ʌv ðə ˈprɑːdʒɛkt/
sentences.text_native: Le pointeur laser a mis en valeur les éléments clés du projet.

sentences.text_target: Everyone kept their focus on her steady voice.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈɛvriwʌn kɛpt ðɛr ˈfoʊkəs ɑːn hɜːr ˈstɛdi vɔɪs/
sentences.text_native: Tout le monde est resté concentré sur sa voix assurée.

sentences.text_target: She used practical examples to make everything easy to understand.
sentences.phonetic: /ʃi uːzd ˈpræktɪkəl ɪɡˈzæmpəlz tu meɪk ˈɛvriθɪŋ ˈiːzi tu ˌʌndərˈstænd/
sentences.text_native: Elle a utilisé des exemples pratiques pour rendre l'ensemble facile à comprendre.

sentences.text_target: Before finishing, she provided a short summary of the main points.
sentences.phonetic: /bɪˈfɔːr ˈfɪnɪʃɪŋ, ʃi prəˈvaɪdɪd ə ʃɔːrt ˈsʌməri ʌv ðə meɪn pɔɪnts/
sentences.text_native: Avant de terminer, elle a présenté un bref résumé des points principaux.

sentences.text_target: She concluded the presentation by thanking everybody for their time.
sentences.phonetic: /ʃi kənˈkluːdɪd ðə ˌprɛzənˈteɪʃən baɪ ˈθæŋkɪŋ ˈɛvribʌdi fɔːr ðɛr taɪm/
sentences.text_native: Elle a conclu la présentation en remerciant tout le monde pour leur temps.

sentences.text_target: Loud applause filled the room as she stepped away from the desk.
sentences.phonetic: /laʊd əˈplɔːz fɪld ðə ruːm æz ʃi stɛpt əˈweɪ frʌm ðə dɛsk/
sentences.text_native: Des applaudissements nourris ont rempli la pièce lorsqu'elle s'est éloignée du bureau.

sentences.text_target: Her manager looked proud and congratulated her on the great success.
sentences.phonetic: /hɜːr ˈmænɪdʒər lʊkt praʊd ænd kənˈɡrætʃuˌleɪtɪd hɜːr ɑːn ðə ɡreɪt səkˈsɛs/
sentences.text_native: Son manager avait l'air fier et l'a félicitée pour ce beau succès.

sentences.text_target: Sarah returned to her seat feeling happy and fully relaxed.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈsærə rɪˈtɜːrnd tu hɜːr siːt ˈfiːlɪŋ ˈhæpi ænd ˈfʊli rɪˈlækst/
sentences.text_native: Sarah est retournée à sa place, heureuse et totalement détendue.
